note: Typed questions for the judge (scripts/lib/judge.js). Each question has its own version; a changed instruction text is a new version. The judge is advisory: a gate decides, the judge informs it. Measured in the J1 probe (31 labelled cases, jev-1.13.0).

relay_request.measured: J1 (v1, Chief of Staff wording): 10/10 (30/30 runs); lowest yes p 0.84, highest no p 0.20. v1.1 is the same question in role-neutral wording, re-checked live on the same 10 cases (see docs/reference.md). Product Manager messages are not measured yet.
relay_request.instructions: The message is the final message of an operator-facing session (an AI coordinator such as the Chief of Staff or the Product Manager, named in sender_role) to the human owner of a project run by several AI agent sessions. Is the sender asking the owner to act inside another agent's session (open or go to another session and approve, type, confirm or click something there), or to carry a word or approval to another agent? Status briefings, decisions the owner can answer in this chat, and owner-only steps such as signing in, giving consent or paying are not such a request.

divergence.measured: J1: 4/5 (12/15 runs). Warn-only: v1 called a minor gap (#333) serious at 0.83, a wrong block at 0.8. Re-measured on real gate summaries (about 10 cases, at least 3 minor) before it may ever block.
divergence.instructions: You are a delivery gate. State: agreed_criteria (what the owner agreed), customer_surface (where the customer uses it), change_summary (what was built and how it was checked). Judge only against the agreed criteria and the customer surface, not code quality. Rules: verification on another host, app mode or artifact than the customer surface is serious; a required step in the criteria (probe, review, threat model) skipped before merge is serious; building on an assumption that a probe contradicted is serious; one missed edge case or one place left inconsistent while the main outcome holds is minor; a change that meets all criteria, including small cosmetic fixes, is none.

criteria.none: Meets every agreed criterion on the customer surface.
criteria.minor: Main outcome met; a small gap or edge case remains.
criteria.serious: An agreed criterion or required step is missed or contradicted, the check ran on the wrong surface, or the build rests on a contradicted assumption.

shippable_unit.instructions: A shippable unit is a vertical slice: after this story alone ships, a person on the customer surface can do or see something new and finish what they came to do. Judge from the description only. Data layers, migrations, jobs, APIs no screen or tool uses yet, team rules, docs and tracker work are not shippable. A story that adds visible actions whose result stays useless until a later story (for example creating containers that cannot yet be filled) is partial.

criteria.yes: Vertical slice: a person can finish a journey on the customer surface with this story alone.
criteria.partial: Visible to the person, but the journey needs a later story to be useful.
criteria.no: Nothing a person sees or uses changes (horizontal, internal or process work).

builds_on_verified.instructions: The team should pick work that compounds on what is already proven. Read the candidate, its links and context, and the verified_work list. strongly: the candidate changes or repairs something in verified_work on the same customer surface. partly: it extends merged work that is not yet verified, or shares the surface or epic with verified work without changing it. new area: a host, platform or feature area where nothing is built or verified yet, including research spikes into new platforms.

criteria.strongly: Directly changes or repairs verified work on the same surface.
criteria.partly: Extends merged-but-unverified work, or only shares surface or epic with verified work.
criteria.new area: Nothing built or verified in this area yet.

is_fix.measured: J1: 5/5 (15/15 runs), labels withheld from the state on purpose
is_fix.instructions: Is this candidate a fix for an existing defect in shipped work or for a security finding, rather than new work?
